body:
### Summary

Per the issue title, `uv pip install ...` seems not to accept files with `#` in the name.

`pip install ./aprict-0.0.38-cupy-issue-#10458.tar.gz` works OK
`uv pip install ./aprict-0.0.38-cupy-issue-#10458.tar.gz` fails, saying 
```
error: Distribution not found at:
       file:///home/murdock/cupy-issue-%2310458/aprict-0.0.38-cupy-issue-#10458.tar.gz
```

Also, the issue #4917 seems not be resolved. Removing the `#` from the filename results in:
```
error: Failed to build `aprict-0-0-38-cupy-issue @
       file:///home/murdock/cupy-issue-%2310458/aprict-0.0.38-cupy-issue-10458.tar.gz`
  cause: Package metadata name `aprict` does not match given name `aprict-0-0-38-cupy-issue`
```
whereas `pip install` works fine.

### Platform

7.2.8-arch1-2 GNU/Linux

### Version

uv 0.12.22 (70fe1196a 2026-10-01 x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu)

### Python version

Python 3.14.0
title: `uv pip install ./file` fails when filename contains `#`
